VisFactor digitizes 20 vision-centric subtests from the Factor-Referenced Cognitive Test (FRCT) battery.

This repository contains the official implementation of VisFactor , a novel benchmark derived from the Factor-Referenced Cognitive Test (FRCT) that digitizes 20 vision-centric subtests from established cognitive psychology assessments.
Place VisFactor.tsv and VisFactor_CoT.tsv in this directory.
python3 run.py --data VisFactor --model GeminiPro2-5 --verbose
We also provide a script to automatically generate some test cases, including CF1-3, CS1-3, MA1, S1-2, SS3, VZ1-2.
We also test GPT-5.1-2025-11-13 with different levels of reasoning efforts.
The best model achieves a score of only 55.9%. Analysis reveals good internal consistency (Cronbach’s α = 0.94) and construct validity (compared to existing vision benchmarks).
